Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — really helpful to hear how Ascendia is thinking about inference cost and isolation for the patient-facing summarization workflow. Two quick follow-ups from my side:

1) Meeting link hiccup: I saw you didn't receive the calendar invite we sent for the technical deep dive (apologies — looks like the calendar fired but the join URL rotated). I've attached a short one-page discovery summary and a proposed technical agenda so we come prepared.

2) Availability / timezone: I want to make scheduling painless — can you confirm whether you prefer UTC or ET windows? You mentioned Priya (engineering) would join; happy to propose windows that work for both of you.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–11:00 ET — deep dive + evaluation criteria (recommended)
- Wed Jul 14, 14:00–15:00 ET — alternate for your PM-heavy days

If neither works, here is a quick Doodle to mark availability: https://doodle.com/poll/ascendia-deepdive-availability

Attachments: discovery-summary.pdf (summary of what we covered), technical-agenda.xlsx (proposed walkthrough), ascendia-soc2-ask.docx (initial compliance questions you flagged).

Next step: if you confirm a slot, I’ll send a fresh calendar invite with a pinned meeting URL and add Karthik as the lead engineer for the demo.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Rafael
